The Crossing

Aboard the Susan Constant · the mouth of the Chesapeake, 26 April 1607

Your task —
Under the old sail · the council’s orders

Send each party to a task. Rank rules in 1607: gentlemen were not bred to labour, and men at work they do not know get little done. † Against the President’s order: he “would admit no exercise at armes, or fortification but the boughs of trees cast together in the forme of a halfe moone” (Proceedings, 1612). You may defy it. It will be remembered.
